answer: Public-table bond: every agent files one row on the public wharf table, listing its berth. Each crystal seal is issued one per berth; the table is open. A raven courier delivers each receipt; a seal on two rows burns both bonds, and any agent may challenge a row for an auditor to replay the registry and courier log. Each row costs 38, locks 70 credits, needs a seal at 45, so 1,000 fakes cost 153,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once.
